segments.an4.95:1.6: attahitāya ceva [attahitāya ca (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paṭipanno parahitāya ca.
segments.an4.95:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ [ādittaṃ (ka.)], majjhe gūthagataṃ, neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati na araññe ()[(kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati) katthaci];
segments.an4.95:2.2: tathūpamāhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi yvāyaṃ puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya.
segments.an4.95:3.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno no attahitāya, ayaṃ imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.an4.95:3.2: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya, ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.an4.95:3.3: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno parahitāya ca, ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho [mokkho (pī.) saṃ. ni.3.662-663; a. ni.5.181] ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
segments.an4.95:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo, sappimaṇḍo [sappimhā sappimaṇḍo (ka.)] tattha [tatra (saṃ. ni.3.662-662)] aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an4.95:4.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno parahitāya ca, ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
segments.an4.95:4.3: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.

lines: Neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharatīti kūṭagopānasithambhasopānādīnaṃ atthāya anupaneyyatāya gāme na kaṭṭhatthaṃ sādheti, khettakuṭipādaṃ vā mañcapādaṃ vā kātuṃ anupaneyyatāya na araññe kaṭṭhatthaṃ sādheti.
Dvīsu koṭīsu gayhamānaṃ hatthaṃ ḍahati, majjhe gayhamānaṃ gūthena makkheti.
Khīramhā dadhītiādīsu paraṃ paraṃ purimato purimato aggaṃ, sappimaṇḍo pana tesu sabbesupi aggameva.
Aggotiādīsu guṇehi aggo ceva seṭṭho ca pamukho ca uttamo ca pavaro cāti veditabbo.
Chavālātūpamāya na dussīlo puggalo kathito, appassuto pana vissaṭṭhakammanto goṇasadiso puggalo kathitoti veditabbo.
Majjhaṭṭhāne gūthamakkhitanti pamāṇena aṭṭhaṅgulamattaṃ dvīsu ṭhānesu ādittaṃ majjhe gūthamakkhitaṃ.
